## Glasp Highlight Export
Select Header Auth on Glasp API: Authorization = Bearer <your access token>. Every 6 hours UTC, read up to 100 pages, format untracked documents, and retain tracking for 30 days. A nonempty final cursor fails without advancing tracking. This template returns text/Markdown; no destination is connected. See README before extending it. No access token is stored in this file.
